## Summary

Yahia Mohamed Zakaria Youssef is a Backend-Heavy Software Engineer based in Egypt. He builds production systems including Telegram commerce platforms, payment pipelines, Docker-based infrastructure, FastAPI/NestJS APIs, and full-stack web applications. He is open to backend engineering roles and freelance projects.
